title: A Phase 3 Study of Orelabrutinib in Patients with Primary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Efficacy and Safety Study Comparing Orelabrutinib to Placebo in Patients With Primary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of orelabrutinib compared to placebo in delaying disability progression in PPMS
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1) 18 to 65 years of age, inclusive, at the time of signing the informed consent.
2. 2) Diagnosed with Primary Progressive MS (PPMS) according to McDonald criteria.
3. 3) Participant must have documented evidence of disability progression independent of clinical relapse observed during the 24 months before Screening.
4. 4) EDSS score between 3.0 to 6.5 points, inclusive, at Screening.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1.	Diagnosed with relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) or secondary progressive MS (SPMS)
2. 2. The participant has any chronic, systemic immunologic disorder other than MS, well-controlled Type 2 diabetes mellitus, or well-controlled thyroid disease). The participant has any other conditions requiring oral (PO), intravenous (IV), intramuscular, or intra-articular corticosteroid therapy.
3. 3.	History or current diagnosis of other neurological disorders that may mimic MS
4. 4.	History of any other significant active medical condition
